'''Quick Vrik''' was an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who was a member of the [[Nova Blades]]. Known as the "Fastest Hydrospanner in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]", he earned his nickname for both his fast starship repairs and his quick trigger finger. After being betrayed and left for dead by the Nova Blades during the [[Dantooine Incursion]], he swore revenge and joined the [[Eternal Alliance]] in their conflict against his former comrades.<ref name="KOTET" />
